summary: Practise supplier due diligence, contract controls, monitoring, and board reporting. Explore the five-day course and its applied exercises.
lede: Third-party risk management training helps risk, procurement, security and continuity professionals assess exposure across external technology and operational services. Participants practise classifying critical services, evaluating supplier due diligence, mapping concentration risk, checking contract controls, setting monitoring and escalation thresholds, coordinating incident notifications, planning exits, and reporting supplier risks to boards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who select, assess, oversee, or report on external technology and operational service providers.
prerequisites: Prior experience with supplier oversight, procurement, information security, business continuity, compliance, internal audit, or operational risk is recommended. You should be able to read supplier contracts or risk documentation relevant to your role. No coding is required. For spreadsheet-based exercises, bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel or compatible spreadsheet software; a commercial licence may be required for Microsoft Excel.
